bookings_closure_check.name: bookings_closure_check
bookings_closure_check.value: ("rental_operations"."bookings"."lifecycle_status" IN ('CANCELLED', 'NO_SHOW')) = ("rental_operations"."bookings"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "rental_operations"."bookings"."closure_reason" IS NOT NULL)

leases_closure_check.name: leases_closure_check
leases_closure_check.value: ("rental_operations"."leases"."operational_status" = 'CANCELLED') = ("rental_operations"."leases"."closed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "rental_operations"."leases"."closure_reason" IS NOT NULL)

occupancies_provenance_check.name: occupancies_provenance_check
occupancies_provenance_check.value:
("rental_operations"."occupancies"."mode" = 'LONG_TERM_RENTAL' AND "rental_operations"."occupancies"."source_lease_id" IS NOT NULL AND "rental_operations"."occupancies"."source_stay_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("rental_operations"."occupancies"."mode" = 'SHORT_TERM_RENTAL' AND "rental_operations"."occupancies"."source_lease_id" IS NULL AND "rental_operations"."occupancies"."source_stay_id" IS NOT NULL)

occupancies_lifecycle_status_check.name: occupancies_lifecycle_status_check
occupancies_lifecycle_status_check.value: ("rental_operations"."occupancies"."lifecycle_status" = 'ACTIVE' AND "rental_operations"."occupancies"."ended_at" IS NULL AND "rental_operations"."occupancies"."end_reason" IS NULL) OR ("rental_operations"."occupancies"."lifecycle_status" = 'ENDED' AND "rental_operations"."occupancies"."ended_at" IS NOT NULL AND "rental_operations"."occupancies"."end_reason" IN ('SCHEDULED', 'EARLY_DEPARTURE', 'EARLY_TERMINATION', 'OVERSTAY'))

operational_blocks_completion_check.name: operational_blocks_completion_check
operational_blocks_completion_check.value: ("rental_operations"."operational_blocks"."status" = 'ACTIVE' AND "rental_operations"."operational_blocks"."completed_at" IS NULL AND "rental_operations"."operational_blocks"."completed_by_actor_id" IS NULL) OR ("rental_operations"."operational_blocks"."status" = 'RELEASED' AND "rental_operations"."operational_blocks"."completed_at" IS NOT NULL AND "rental_operations"."operational_blocks"."completed_by_actor_id" IS NOT NULL)

property_inspections_provenance_check.name: property_inspections_provenance_check
property_inspections_provenance_check.value:
("rental_operations"."property_inspections"."inspection_type" = 'ENTRY' AND "rental_operations"."property_inspections"."occupancy_id" IS NULL AND (
      ("rental_operations"."property_inspections"."mode" = 'LONG_TERM_RENTAL' AND "rental_operations"."property_inspections"."source_lease_id" IS NOT NULL AND "rental_operations"."property_inspections"."source_booking_id" IS NULL)
      OR ("rental_operations"."property_inspections"."mode" = 'SHORT_TERM_RENTAL' AND "rental_operations"."property_inspections"."source_lease_id" IS NULL AND "rental_operations"."property_inspections"."source_booking_id" IS NOT NULL)))
    OR ("rental_operations"."property_inspections"."inspection_type" = 'EXIT' AND "rental_operations"."property_inspections"."occupancy_id" IS NOT NULL AND "rental_operations"."property_inspections"."source_lease_id" IS NULL AND "rental_operations"."property_inspections"."source_booking_id" IS NULL)

rental_allocations_provenance_check.name: rental_allocations_provenance_check
rental_allocations_provenance_check.value:
("rental_operations"."rental_allocations"."allocation_type" = 'LEASE' AND "rental_operations"."rental_allocations"."rental_mode" = 'LONG_TERM_RENTAL' AND "rental_operations"."rental_allocations"."source_lease_id" IS NOT NULL AND "rental_operations"."rental_allocations"."source_booking_id" IS NULL AND "rental_operations"."rental_allocations"."source_operational_block_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("rental_operations"."rental_allocations"."allocation_type" = 'BOOKING' AND "rental_operations"."rental_allocations"."rental_mode" = 'SHORT_TERM_RENTAL' AND "rental_operations"."rental_allocations"."source_lease_id" IS NULL AND "rental_operations"."rental_allocations"."source_booking_id" IS NOT NULL AND "rental_operations"."rental_allocations"."source_operational_block_id" IS NULL AND "rental_operations"."rental_allocations"."end_at" IS NOT NULL)
    OR ("rental_operations"."rental_allocations"."allocation_type" = 'OPERATIONAL_BLOCK' AND "rental_operations"."rental_allocations"."source_lease_id" IS NULL AND "rental_operations"."rental_allocations"."source_booking_id" IS NULL AND "rental_operations"."rental_allocations"."source_operational_block_id" IS NOT NULL AND "rental_operations"."rental_allocations"."end_at" IS NOT NULL)

stays_actual_interval_check.name: stays_actual_interval_check
stays_actual_interval_check.value: "rental_operations"."stays"."actual_check_out_at" IS NULL OR ("rental_operations"."stays"."actual_check_in_at" IS NOT NULL AND "rental_operations"."stays"."actual_check_out_at" > "rental_operations"."stays"."actual_check_in_at")
